reference.prompt: Photorealistic documentary still, historical recreation of the Panama Canal excavation, circa 1885–1910. Medium-wide shot at eye level: three Afro-Caribbean laborers in sweat-stained loose light cotton shirts with rolled sleeves, dark work trousers and worn straw or felt hats, swinging iron pickaxes and digging with long-handled shovels into a steep slope of reddish-brown clay and broken rock. Dense green tropical rainforest on the ridge behind, humid haze, overcast diffused light, muted natural colors with slight film grain, 35mm lens. Keep the action centered with generous space above and below, wide framing.
reference.negativePrompt: modern clothing, printed T-shirts, baseball caps, helmets, hard hats, high-visibility vests, rubber boots, sunglasses, wristwatches, plastic, machinery, vehicles, power lines, text, captions, logos, watermark, extra limbs, distorted hands, distorted faces

source.prompt: Historical documentary recreation, Panama, late 19th century. The laborers keep swinging their pickaxes into the reddish clay and shoveling loose earth; clods and dust fall down the slope; their shirts move slightly; humid haze drifts over the jungle behind them. Slow, steady camera push-in. Natural real-time motion, realistic, muted film-like colors, one continuous shot.

La aprobación final es de Hans.

source.prompt: Animate this black-and-white 1913 photograph of the Culebra Cut during the construction of the Panama Canal. Keep it black and white with the original grain and contrast. Subtle, realistic motion only: steam and smoke rise and drift from the steam shovel, the workers in the foreground move and work with their tools, a faint haze drifts across the cut. Very slow camera push-in. Preserve the composition, the people, the machines and the terrain; one continuous shot.

review.note: Revisión técnica (0.2–7.8 s, 640 px; se usan 0–3.05 s): conserva B/N, la pala 230, las vías y la cuadrilla. Desviaciones: la forma oscura de arriba a la izquierda de la foto se vuelve una locomotora, el penacho de vapor cambia de forma, el encuadre sube levemente y el grano se suaviza. Aceptado sin reintento (plausible: trenes de tierra en la Culebra), señalado a Hans. La aprobación final es de Hans.
